name: Wojak (Feels Guy)
blurb: A simple drawing of a sad bald man, used to say "I know that feel" and in endless variants
title: Wojak Meme: Meaning, Origin & Variants
description: Wojak, or Feels Guy, is a black-outline drawing of a sad bald man. It appeared on a Polish imageboard around 2009 and spread via Krautchan and 4chan.
answer: Wojak, also called Feels Guy, is a crude black-outline drawing of a bald man with a quiet, wistful expression, used to show sadness, regret or relatable loneliness. The image comes from a Polish imageboard and was archived as early as December 2009; in 2010 a user called "Wojak" (Polish for "soldier") posted it on the German imageboard Krautchan, and by 2011 it was a 4chan staple with the caption "I know that feel, bro". Since then it has turned into a huge family of characters such as Doomer, Soyjak and NPC.

body: The original Wojak is a pale, bald man drawn in a few thick black lines: small eyes, a slight frown, no background. He looks tired and a little sad, but not dramatic, which made him perfect for small everyday disappointments.
Classic Wojak comics show two of them hugging, with one saying "I know that feel, bro": a joke about sharing an awkward or lonely feeling.

head: Date
Event
rows: Earliest archived copy of the drawing, which circulated on the Polish imageboard Vichan as "ciepła twarz" (warm face).
A Krautchan user named "Wojak" posts it on the German imageboard; the name sticks.
Wojak becomes popular on 4chan with "that feel" and "I know that feel, bro".
The Doomer Wojak (beanie, cigarette, nihilistic mood) first appears on 4chan.
The grey, expressionless NPC Wojak spreads and gets wide media coverage.
The Soyjak, an open-mouthed mocking version, gets its own dedicated site and becomes a major branch.

sections.h: Variants and how people use them
body: Wojak became less one meme than a drawing style. Each variant stands for a type of person:

ul: Feels Guy: plain sadness or "that feel when..." moments.
Doomer: a young man who feels hopeless; often paired with a "Doomer girl" (from 2020).
NPC: someone mocked as repeating opinions without thinking.
Brainlet and Big Brain: a tiny-brained Wojak versus a huge-brained one, for dumb versus overthinking takes.
Soyjak: a gaping, excited face used to mock overexcited fans.

body: Wojaks are also used as quick characters in comparison memes, often next to Pepe the Frog or the Gigachad photo.

Wojak is a classic that never stopped mutating. The original Feels Guy is less common now, but its descendants are everywhere in comment sections and reaction images. Some variants grew out of insult culture on imageboards, so the same face can be friendly or mocking depending on the version and the caption.

faq.a: Wojak is Polish for "soldier" or "fighter". It was the username of the Krautchan user who spread the drawing in 2010.

faq.q: What does "I know that feel, bro" mean?
faq.a: It is the classic Wojak caption, said by one Wojak hugging another: "I understand exactly how you feel", usually about something awkward or lonely.

faq.q: What is the difference between Wojak and Soyjak?
faq.a: Wojak is the original sad, quiet face. Soyjak is a later variant with a wide-open mouth and glasses, used to mock people who get overexcited.
